title: Dick Russell's 1994 taped interview with Puharich

tellings.quote: I met Puharich once. In fact, I I tape recorded an interview with him. It was '94, literally the year before Puharich died/was found dead mysteriously.

plain: In 1994 a man named Dick Russell is said to have met and tape-recorded an interview with Puharich, a scientist the episode's title calls a CIA scientist who contacted an alien council. A researcher named Greg Malatzi relays the account, in which the speaker says the tape was made "literally the year before Puharich died/was found dead mysteriously." The tape would be one of the last records of the man in his own words.
